name: Eight-Legged Menaces
summary: Eight-Legged Menaces is a militia contract issued by Watcher Dodds in Duskwood. With the western border overrun by aggressive venom web spiders, the understaffed Night Watch relies on wandering adventurers to cull the brood before more guards are caught in their webs.

sections.title: A Border Under Siege
sections.body: Along the western road linking Westfall to Duskwood, the dense canopy gives way to tangled thickets choked with webbing. As darkness tightened its grip on Grand Hamlet and turned it into the haunted grove known today, the local arachnids mutated into monstrous predators. Pygmy venom web spiders now infest the brush in swarms, threatening travelers and encroaching upon the fragile defensive lines maintained by the Night Watch.

sections.title: The Burden on the Night Watch
sections.body: Stationed far from the safety of Darkshire, Watcher Dodds finds himself desperately short on troops. Commander Althea Ebonlocke cannot spare reinforcements to secure remote outposts when undead and worgen press against the township itself. Left isolated, Dodds has already watched comrades fall victim to the spiders, discovering men hanging upside down in the canopy as paralytic venom slowly liquefied them for feeding.

faq.answer: Watcher Dodds, a member of the Night Watch posted at a small camp in Duskwood, offers this task to travelers capable of clearing out the spiders.

faq.q: Why can't the Night Watch handle the spiders themselves?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke must concentrate her meager garrison near Darkshire to repel relentless undead assaults. Dodds lacks the manpower to assault the infested border nests without abandoning his post.
The pygmy venom web spiders nest heavily in the western woods of Duskwood, lurking in the brush just off the main road coming in from Westfall.

faq.q: What makes these spiders so dangerous to the watch?
faq.answer: Aside from their sheer numbers, they possess a potent venom that paralyzes and dissolves flesh, leaving ensnared Night Watchmen helpless and strung up in the boughs as easy prey.

faq.q: Are these the only spiders in Duskwood?
faq.answer: No. The pygmy venom webs are merely the smaller broodlings. Deeper into the woods dwell much larger, deadlier specimens that pose an even graver danger to travelers.

faq.q: Why has the insect and spider population grown so aggressively?
faq.answer: The pervasive magical corruption that blankets Duskwood has twisted the indigenous wildlife, accelerating their aggression, size, and lethality across the blighted forest.

angles.text: The Night Watch stands entirely alone without aid from the House of Nobles, making any support Alliance travelers provide vital for keeping the roads open.
The venom web spiders of Duskwood are vicious beasts requiring careful footwork and anti-venom preparation to hunt effectively.
